titleZh: AI能否取代种薯拔除病株团队？三款荷兰机器人迈出下一步
summaryZh: 本文介绍了荷兰三家制造商正在商用田块中测试AI驱动的拔除病株机器人，用于替代种薯生产中最劳动密集的环节——识别并移除患病和异型植株。虽然技术仍在开发中，但算法学习速度惊人，未来可能匹配甚至超越经验丰富的拔除团队。文章提供了现场演示的观察，并指出人工角色的转变趋势，对智慧农业从业者具有前瞻参考价值。
featuredReason: 本文展示了AI与机器人技术在种薯生产关键环节的突破性应用，对智慧畜牧行业人士理解跨领域自动化趋势、借鉴算法快速迭代经验具有启发意义。
contentFull:
Can AI replace seed potato rogueing crews? Three Dutch robots take the next step

 02-07 | Smart farming | Article

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

The potato selection robot is now a reality. Will the experienced selector soon be left behind? Not for the time being, but their role is set to change. Photo: Martin Smits

 Removing diseased and off-type plants is one of the most labour-intensive jobs in seed potato production. This season, 3 Dutch manufacturers are testing AI-powered rogueing robots in commercial fields. Future Farming visited the first field demonstrations to see how the machines perform in practice.
